description: Link from a Swell product to the Printful product it was synced from. Written by the app under $app.printful.

sync_product_id.description: Printful product this Swell product was created from or linked to

sync_variant_count.description: Variant count Printful reported at the last sync. A different count on the next listing marks the product for re-sync

date_synced.description: When this product last matched Printful

linked.description: The merchant made this product in Swell and linked it to Printful. The sync then only links its variants, and never changes its options, prices or photos
